from: live test 3 (concept): kept every gate change (two pins, a dozen in words)

shots.summary: A big grid of icon discs on navy (a town). A lottery drum turns; scattered discs light bright teal and drift toward the centre. Words: representative, selected by lottery, a shared challenge.
shots.action: The teal circle wipe shrinks away to reveal a dense grid of small round-headed icon discs in muted support colours at 50% (too many to count at a glance, edge to edge, right two thirds). 0.4 s a lottery drum pictogram in a house teal disc (upper left) turns two slow revolutions (ease-in-out, 2.4 s). 1.6 s "representative" (h2) lands left. 3.2 to 4.6 s discs scattered across the whole grid light bright teal in a seeded random order (no number shown, never a neat group). 4.4 s "selected by lottery" lands. 5.4 to 6.6 s the lit discs drift toward the centre into a loose, overlapping cluster while the rest dim to 25%. 6.6 s "a shared challenge" lands and a small white challenge card (blank lines, no text) settles in the cluster. Source line at 2.0 s.
shots.transition_in: Teal circle wipe from S4 shrinks into the grid centre.
shots.transition_out: Continuous: the lit cluster flows into the bar strip (S6).
reads: 0.0 to 0.4 s: wipe clears, town grid
5.4 to 6.6 s: lit discs gather loosely
shots.notes: Storyboard: no countable group. Lit discs stay scattered, then overlap in the cluster so no count reads.

shots.summary: Colour wipe to navy. A plain US outline map in house teal, states not labelled. "Already happening". Exactly two pins: Hillview and Riverton.
shots.action: 0.0 to 0.45 s bright teal bar wipe clears to navy. 0.4 s the contiguous US map (house teal land, navy state borders, no labels, Alaska and Hawaii hidden) fades up, right of centre at 0.84 scale. 0.8 s "Already happening" (h2, two lines) lands in the left column, clear of the map; 1.1 s source line bottom left. 1.5 s a white pin with a gold tip drops on Hillview, State A; 1.9 s a second on Riverton, State B (500 ms ease-out, no bounce). Exactly two pins, no other cities. 2.4 to 3.5 s hold.
shots.transition_in: Bright teal bar wipe clears to navy.
shots.transition_out: Continuous: camera pushes into State A (S16).
shots.notes: Pins placed from coordinates: Hillview 38.48 N, 107.88 W; Riverton 41.08 N, 81.52 W (north-east State B). Style frame pass: the title moved off the map into the left column, and the source line was added.

shots.summary: "a dozen Community Proposals" in Display Sans with "a dozen" in gold and the source line under it. Then a check mark card: "Clear recommendations for housing".
shots.action: 0.0 to 0.45 s teal bar wipe clears to navy. 0.5 s "a dozen Community Proposals" (Display Sans 900, 96px, white, two lines, "a dozen" gold) rises in, centre left; 0.9 s source line directly under it. 1.0 to 4.4 s hold. 4.6 s the words slide up 120px and dim to 60%; 4.8 s a white card rises with a gold check disc at its left: "Clear recommendations for housing" (navy Display Sans 900, 56px), source line under the card. 5.6 to 9.3 s hold. Never the numeral 12, never a countable row of cards.
shots.transition_out: Continuous: the card leaves upward and the strips stack in (S19).
